title: Ox Passion Blue Razz Gummy Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Blue Razz Gummy captures the bold, tangy bite of Blue Raspberry with the soft, chewy sweetness of classic Gummy confectionery. The sharp, slightly tart berry notes are balanced by a sugary undertone, creating a layered flavour that shifts from zesty to sweet with every inhale. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, delivering well-defined flavour with a smooth throat hit. Optimised for use with pod vape kits and starter devices, it ensures fast nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
